items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: And many more tunes, too, and Clarence Williams. They are the base of my tunes, or repertoire in French.

ctx.x: Oh, no, I can't. I can't. You can't name several. All the King Oliver tunes I like, all of them. And many more tunes, too, and Clarence Williams. They are the base of my tunes, or repertoire in French. In English, too, we say that. Oh, yes. All right.
